# Finland

[global-law](../) / Finland

8 repositories under this folder (1 legislation, whole country, 7 case law). Each row links to the repository's current `main`; the folder of the same path is the submodule global-law pins and reads. "Coverage" is what the corpus says of itself; freshness is global-law's monitor.

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 57% | 37% | not applicable | 99% |

The Constitution is held with its full amendment history, and the case law is close to everything Finlex publishes for all 7 courts, but 3 of the 7 essential acts are missing: rikoslaki, oikeudenkäymiskaari and esitutkintalaki. ROL, oikeustoimilaki and kauppalaki are current text only. National acts are 2,291 of the 6,239 in force that Finlex consolidates (37%).

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
